subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should this umbrella issue be split into separate docs/product tasks, and which remaining gaps should OpenClaw core own now?
rationale: Several requested behaviors are now implemented on main while the remaining gaps cross stable docs, update, auth, systemd, and audit boundaries that require owner prioritization before implementation.

options.title: Split remaining gaps
options.body: Create or designate narrow follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff reporting, and any audit expansion while preserving the current implemented bind, dry-run, token, and audit behavior.

options.title: Keep one canonical umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the single tracker and require future PRs to clearly scope each sub-task against already-implemented behavior.

options.title: Close implemented parts only
options.body: Close or mark done for implemented sub-asks and reject broader self-healing scripts or backup workflows that do not belong in core.

recommendation.title: Split remaining gaps
recommendation.body: Create or designate narrow follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff reporting, and any audit expansion while preserving the current implemented bind, dry-run, token, and audit behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the strongest overlap with audit CLI, Gateway safety, and update repair work.
